name: Anwen
greeting: That is Oren's. Leave the pockets turned in; he keeps things in them.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The small coat is heavier at one cuff. Three crooked red stitches hold a tear shut. Kael folds the sleeve beneath it, clear of the wet edge.

lines: Anwen: He did. I threaded the needle. He would not let me do the rest.
Anwen: Bram drove the cart. Sella took Oren beside her. He left this because the sun was out.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Anwen leaves room on the bench beside the coat. She has not put it away.
